title: Startup Investors Scraper (OpenVC)

lists.title: Investor lists
lists.description: OpenVC lists to scrape. Pass a sector keyword (ai → ai-investors), a full slug (fintech-investors), or a full https://www.openvc.app/investor-lists/... URL. Each list yields public investor rows with check size and thesis.

investorTypes.title: Investor type filter
investorTypes.description: Optional. Keep investors whose type contains one of these strings (e.g. VC firm, Angel, Family office, Accelerator).

stages.title: Funding stage filter
stages.description: Optional. Keep investors covering a stage that contains one of these (e.g. Prototype, Early Revenue, Scaling, Seed, Series A).

geographies.title: Geography filter
geographies.description: Optional. Keep investors targeting a country/region that contains one of these (e.g. USA, France, Europe).

checkSizeContains.title: Check size contains
checkSizeContains.description: Optional. Keep investors whose check-size text contains one of these (e.g. $500k, $1M).

leadOnly.title: Lead investors only
leadOnly.description: If true, keep only investors that lead rounds (Lead = Yes/Always/Sometimes — excludes Never/No).

maxInvestors.title: Max investors
maxInvestors.description: Maximum investor rows to return across all lists. Each persisted row charges $0.025. Prefill 10 keeps quality tests cheap.

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
